scripts.test: vitest run && npm run build && node scripts/csp-guard.mjs
scripts.test:e2e:real: sh -c 'export HRAMATKA_PROXY_PORT=$(node e2e/resolve-e2e-port.mjs); export HRAMATKA_E2E_ORIGIN=https://127.0.0.1:$HRAMATKA_PROXY_PORT; exec playwright test -c playwright.real-backend.config.ts "$@"' --
scripts.test:e2e:real:empty: sh -c 'export HRAMATKA_PROXY_PORT=$(node e2e/resolve-e2e-port.mjs); export HRAMATKA_E2E_ORIGIN=https://127.0.0.1:$HRAMATKA_PROXY_PORT; exec playwright test -c playwright.real-backend-empty.config.ts "$@"' --
scripts.test:e2e:real:under-capacity: sh -c 'export HRAMATKA_PROXY_PORT=$(node e2e/resolve-e2e-port.mjs); export HRAMATKA_E2E_ORIGIN=https://127.0.0.1:$HRAMATKA_PROXY_PORT; exec playwright test -c playwright.real-backend-under-capacity.config.ts "$@"' --
